name: anderson
description: Gated maker/checker pipeline: plan (opus/medium) -> grill (you harden it) -> plan-review (a rung above the planner) -> [human] -> implement (sonnet/medium) -> diff-review (read-only) -> [human], then ship (commit + PR). Review effort is tiered off the plan Scorecard: critical runs both gates at xhigh, hard runs diff-review at xhigh. Self-contained agents; no external skills required. Big tasks are sized by tokens and split into Linear sub-issues with contracts between slices.
